Please read this notice when using the information and links on this website.

About this website

This website provides professional and chamber information about Sumit Gaba, Advocate, together with links to court services and an independent advocate directory. It is intended for general information.

Legal advice and engagement

The information here does not constitute legal advice or an opinion on any individual matter. Advice depends on the facts, documents and circumstances of the case.

Viewing this website or making an enquiry does not by itself establish an advocate-client relationship. Representation is subject to the advocate accepting the matter and agreeing the terms of engagement.

External websites

Court-resource links lead to websites operated by the relevant courts or authorities. eCourtsIndia is a separate private platform. These external websites are responsible for their own content, services and availability.

Case information

Case status, hearing dates and orders should be checked with the relevant court records. Directory entries and third-party summaries may be incomplete or out of date.

Contact details

Please contact the office to confirm availability and the appropriate meeting location before travelling.
